event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 63 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 30.14 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,331 feet. 

This is the 1st time the #6 & 12 PSM qualifiers have met in the Final round
In the last 10 years the #6 PSM qualifier has won 4 times.

Hartford is 4 - 3 against Coughlin Jr. in prior events and this is the first time they have faced
each other in a final round.

They both take their time staging, finally both go in.  Coughlin Jr. with the starting line advantage
and never trailed for the win.

He wins for the first time 41 races and wins his sixth Pro Stock Wally.
